emails.subject: URGENT: SAE Notification - Site 201 (Metropolis General) - Participant 450-008 - Protocol NGX-FTD-002
emails.body:
Dear Alex,

Please be advised of a Serious Adverse Event for a participant in the NGX-FTD-002 study at Site 201.

Participant ID: 450-008 (Part B, FTD Cohort)
Event: Hospitalization for Pneumonia
Date of Onset: 2023-11-05

The participant was admitted to Metropolis General Hospital yesterday evening and is currently stable. We are gathering all necessary source documentation and will complete the formal SAE report form shortly.

Please let us know of any immediate questions.

Best regards,

Dr. Maria Garcia
Principal Investigator
Metropolis General Hospital
Site 201

emails.subject: Re: URGENT: SAE Notification - Site 201 (Metropolis General) - Participant 450-008 - Protocol NGX-FTD-002
emails.body:
Dear Dr. Garcia,

Thank you for the prompt notification of this SAE for participant 450-008. The safety team has been alerted.

Please ensure the completed SAE report form is submitted to us within 24 hours of your initial awareness of the event. Also, please ensure all related source documentation is uploaded to the eTMF as it becomes available.

We appreciate your diligence.

Best,

Alex Johnson
Clinical Research Associate
NeuroGenix Pharma

emails.subject: Re: URGENT: SAE Notification - Site 201 (Metropolis General) - Participant 450-008 - Protocol NGX-FTD-002
emails.body:
Hi Alex,

Please find the completed SAE Report Form for participant 450-008 attached to this email.

We are currently uploading the initial source documents (hospital admission notes, initial diagnosis) to the portal. We will continue to upload further documentation as we receive it.

Could you please confirm receipt of the attached form?

Thank you,

David Chen
Clinical Research Coordinator
Metropolis General Hospital
Site 201

description: An urgent email from the Principal Investigator at Site 201 reporting a Serious Adverse Event (SAE) for a participant in the FTD cohort (Part B). The participant was hospitalized for pneumonia. The thread shows Alex Johnson acknowledging receipt, requesting the completed SAE report form within 24 hours, and following up to ensure all source documentation has been uploaded and the event has been entered correctly in the safety database.
